ENTRY_EXPIRY_MISMATCH.complete_evidence: R has complete history through its terminal/open state at report_date
ENTRY_EXPIRY_MISMATCH.definition: P is complete EXPIRED_UNTRIGGERED at T+10 and R first trigger delay is >10
ENTRY_EXPIRY_MISMATCH.new_rule_trade: R creates a triggered trade outside the P entry-validity contract
ENTRY_EXPIRY_MISMATCH.unresolved_candidate: P cannot prove T+10 expiry and R lacks a complete path; NOT_YET_ELIGIBLE rows are excluded from potentially affected count

TIME_EXIT_MISMATCH.definition: same signal and first-entry date, first entry T+1..T+9, P completes with T+10 TIME_EXIT, and R continues beyond P exit
TIME_EXIT_MISMATCH.entry_identity: same canonical signal_id and same first_trigger_date; entry_price equality is reported separately
TIME_EXIT_MISMATCH.unresolved_candidate: same known early entry but P or R post-entry path is incomplete

decision_rule.A: choose only if repository contract defines formal performance as prospective execution reconstruction and R deviation is incorrect
decision_rule.B: choose only if repository contract explicitly supports independent rule simulation; separate labels, counts and UI are required
decision_rule.C: choose if contract evidence is materially conflicting or insufficient to determine canonical meaning
decision_rule.selection_constraint: never choose from which model has better returns

metric_denominators.delta: MODEL_R minus MODEL_P on the same primary intersection
metric_denominators.eligible_signals: signal_date < data_cutoff and both models have a T+1 opportunity in the selected intersection
metric_denominators.payoff_ratio: average positive realized return / abs(average negative realized return)
metric_denominators.profit_factor: sum positive realized returns / abs(sum negative realized returns)
metric_denominators.returns: complete numeric realized return rows only; no open/ambiguous/incomplete/censored rows
metric_denominators.target_stop_time_exit_rates: exit count / closed_trades; ambiguous is not a closed trade

missing_data_rules.all_missing_observations: retain missing/null; never use 0 or future observations
missing_data_rules.model_r_expiry_metric: NOT_APPLICABLE because R has no expiry; report untriggered_to_report separately
missing_data_rules.primary_returns: only complete, identity-consistent P/R intersection; numeric realized returns only
missing_data_rules.secondary_counts: include incomplete, censored, conflict and not-yet-eligible states without adding them to return denominators

model_p.earlier_entry_at_t_plus_10: TIME_EXIT at T+10 close unless an earlier stop/target terminal event occurs
model_p.entry_day_sellability: entry session cannot sell; next XSHG session is sellable
model_p.fill: open when opening gap is at/above trigger, otherwise canonical trigger
model_p.first_entry: first canonical trigger on XSHG T+1 through T+10
model_p.missing_observation: path is unverified/incomplete; missing is never zero-filled or repaired with future bars
model_p.name: MODEL_P_CURRENT_PROSPECTIVE_SEMANTICS
model_p.stop_target: sellable bar open-first gap, then low/high; same-bar stop+target is AMBIGUOUS_SAME_BAR
model_p.t_plus_10_first_trigger: entry allowed; first legal next session handles exit/time-exit

model_r.entry_day_sellability: entry session cannot sell; next XSHG session is sellable
model_r.fill: canonical trigger price; daily open is not used
model_r.first_entry: first post-signal XSHG session through report_date with high >= canonical trigger
model_r.name: MODEL_R_CURRENT_STRATEGY_RULE_PERFORMANCE_SEMANTICS
model_r.stop_target: sellable bar low/high at canonical rule price; same-bar stop+target is AMBIGUOUS_SAME_BAR
model_r.t_plus_10_or_later_first_trigger: allowed while report_date contains the session
model_r.time_exit: none; a trade may remain OPEN through report_date
